title: NAFTA: Genesis, Disputes, and Trade Realities

scenes.text: Can three neighbour nations trade together without losing jobs or local control?
scenes.narration: Imagine three giant neighbours deciding to tear down all trade borders between them. That is NAFTA, the world's first trade pact between rich and developing countries!

scenes.text: Three school friends sharing tiffin boxes freely while keeping their own household rules.
scenes.narration: Think of this as an analogy: three school friends agree to share tiffin snacks freely at lunch. They swap food without taxes, but each friend still manages their own home independently.

scenes.heading: Core Features of NAFTA
items: Complete elimination of tariffs on goods
Most Favoured Nation status for all members
Equal investment rights and government procurement preference
Covers dispute settlements, intellectual property, and labour laws
scenes.narration: Formed in 1994 from an earlier US-Canada deal, NAFTA created a twenty trillion dollar market. It scrapped import taxes and gave members equal commercial preference, though it never created a shared government like the European Union.

scenes.heading: Rules of Origin in Action
scenes.narration: Here is the trick called rules of origin. A Mexican factory cannot simply repackage cheap foreign parts; a significant share of the car must originate in member countries to enter America tax-free.

scenes.heading: US Grievances Against Partners

columns.title: Mexico
items: Lower Mexican wages suppressed US pay

scenes.narration: Even between close partners, frictions arose. American critics complained that Mexico's factory policies pulled manufacturing jobs south, while Canada faced complaints over dairy protections and lumber exports.

scenes.heading: Politics Versus Economic Reality
scenes.narration: President Trump attacked NAFTA to win support from working-class voters who lost factory jobs. Yet in reality, cheaper groceries, stable oil imports, and joint competitiveness against China made the deal an overall win-win.

items: World's first developed-developing country free trade bloc in 1994
Enforced rules of origin alongside labour and IPR rules
Delivered mutual economic gains despite sharp US political criticism
scenes.narration: To sum up: NAFTA united three distinct economies into a purely commercial powerhouse. Despite political battles over factory jobs and border walls, mutual economic gains kept the partnership indispensable.
